summary: Foremost Clean Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting receipt of a C$50,000 grant from Saskatchewan's Targeted Mineral Exploration Incentive program and a grant of equity awards (201,969 stock options and 266,035 restricted share units) to directors, officers, employees, and consultants under its Long-Term Incentive Plan. No acquisition, divestiture, or special situation transaction is involved. The filing is a routine update on provincial funding and equity compensation, which are ordinary operational and governance matters. No deal terms or special situation mechanics apply. There is no risk-arb angle or regulatory clock to monitor.
